method: Fresh combined mechanics/notes coverage census over the live 474-record canonical skill set, excluding every skill with a registered current-evidence audit. The eight shortest remaining records were selected and rechecked against current skill-specific references.
evidence_boundaries: Exact frame data and patch-independent scaling formulas are not inferred.
Acquisition endpoints remain separate from reward probabilities.
Current evidence was used to resolve the stale Emperor's Blast/Hercule attribution.
